recommendation: Streaming default remains **MiniMax `speech-2.8-hd` + `stream:true`** (product clone; s1 t_first p50 676 / p95 766). StepFun Step Plan WS (`linjiajiejie`) is not slower to first audio on the ack (p50 **664** / p95 **707**; after-text 468). It *is* slower to finish (t_total p50 1379 vs MiniMax HD stream 985; s1 duration 1280 so rtf ≈ 1.08). `instruction` moved the signal on 4/4 directed sentences: s3 Δrms +0.013 (louder), s4 Δdur **+1120 ms** and Δrms −0.008 (slower/quieter — matches 「放轻、放慢」), s5 +400 ms / −0.011 rms, s6 +320 ms / −0.005 rms. Those are objective envelope changes, not a listen score. First-audio is not the reason to refuse StepFun WS; timbre (stock 邻家姐姐 vs MiniMax clone) and higher t_total are. Owner decides expressiveness on `blind-short/`.
